exposure: Previous maternal history of renal colic
cohort: 52 pregnant women who underwent double-J ureteric stenting for urologic disorders, compared with 63 pregnant women without urinary pathology
finding: After propensity score matching, double-J stenting in pregnant women with urologic disorders was associated with significantly higher rates of cesarean delivery, preterm labor, premature rupture of membranes, preterm birth, and postpartum UTI.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were significantly higher in the group who underwent double-J stenting.
